description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'Secret' that models a secret entity with a key and value, provides methods to create instances, access properties, convert to configuration objects, and overrides standard Object methods.

classes.name: Secret
classes.description: An immutable class representing a secret with a name and a value, including factory method, getters, configuration conversion, and overridden equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Secret instance with specified key and value.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name (key) of the secret.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the secret.

methods.name: toConfig
methods.description: Converts the secret object into a Config object with name and value fields.
